freeTierSummary.en: Free plan includes $10/month in API credits (per the official pricing page). No credit card required. Token conversion is not published; actual limits are shown in the console. Free-tier calls may be used to improve services (can be toggled off in the console).
freeTierSummary.zh-CN: 免费计划每月 $10 API 额度（官网定价页明示），免信用卡。token 换算比例官方未公开，具体限额以控制台为准；免费调用可能被用于改进服务（可在控制台关闭）。
